banner.title: maintenance
banner.tagline: A daily janitor that clears dead unpack attempts from the shared downloads volume, and alerts before SABnzbd pauses.

explainer.title: Clear the dead attempts, warn before the pause

steps.title: Schedule
steps.text: The downloads-janitor CronJob runs daily at 05:30 and mounts the shared-downloads claim at /data/downloads.
steps.scene: a clock face above a volume with a daily tick mark

steps.title: Clear
steps.text: It removes _UNPACK_ and _FAILED_ directories untouched for 24 hours, and empty leftover directories older than 7 days. Only depth 2 under usenet/complete is in scope.
steps.scene: a broom sweeping stale folder tiles into a bin

steps.title: Warn
steps.text: Two alerts watch free space. At 15% free it warns; at 7% it goes critical, before SABnzbd's 100G auto-pause trips.
steps.scene: a gauge needle crossing two red warning marks

art.about: a scheduled janitor for a shared volume
art.title: How the downloads janitor works
